candidate_windows.window_text:
Base Model We use LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, LLaMA-2-70B (Touvron et al., 2023b), and Mistral-7B (Jiang et al., 2023) as the base models of our experiments.

Training Details We only calculate loss on outputs, setting epoch to 3, learning rate to $2e^{-5}$ and

batch size to 256. For Mistral-7B, we set learning rate to $1e^{-53}$ . We use DeepSpeed ZeRO3 (Rasley et al., 2020) for LLaMA-2-70B and FSDP (Zhao et al., 2023) for the other three. All experiments are implemented on Nvidia A100-80GB GPUs.
